text:
Maya (CSM): FYI Claymore (Raj) reached out: they can raise a PO for 60% of renewal, want to pay remaining 40% by card. also asking if onboarding credit (from trial) can be applied up front so their enablement can start this week. renewal date is end of month.
Liam (Finance): mixing PO + card is okay but we need clarity on billing entity and payment timing. our default is full PO or full ACH/CC. any precedent for 60/40? :thinking_face:
Maya (CSM): quick recall: we did a 60/40 split once for Marlin, with card captured immediately for the non-PO portion. ops allowed a 2-week dev seat unlock before full provisioning.
Nora (Legal): @Maya paste the proposed amendment text here. must confirm no contract language changes beyond payment path and credits. include fallback if card declines.
Maya (CSM): draft amendment: ```
Amendment: Customer may submit a Purchase Order covering up to sixty percent (60%) of the Renewal Commitment. The remaining forty percent (40%) shall be charged to Customer's credit card on file upon execution of this Amendment. Any onboarding credit previously granted to Customer shall be applied at the time of invoice issuance and may be used to offset the initial card charge. Provisioning of additional production seats is contingent on receipt of PO (for PO-covered portion) and successful card authorization for the remaining balance.```
Raj (Claymore): that looks OK. we can charge the card. prefer onboarding credit applied before card capture so the net charge is lower. also need 15 dev seats unlocked Monday for data migration tests.
DevOps: we can open 15 dev seats as non-prod for migration. note: non-prod seats have reduced throughput.
Liam (Finance): we'll need card auth or token before provisioning. if onboarding credit applies, we need a statement of credit amount to zero-out part of the charge. also need vendor W-9 if billing entity differs from contract.
RenewalBot: Reminder Renewal for Claymore due 2026-04-30; seats: 85; term: 12 months.
Nora (Legal): minor edit: add clause for card decline and retry attempts + late fee language. change line to: "Card authorization shall be attempted; in the event of a declined authorization, Provider will notify Customer and may suspend provisioning pending payment; standard late fees apply."
Maya (CSM): @Raj can you confirm the card tokenization email (billing@claymore.com) and the onboarding-credit amount your finance team expects to apply? need both to proceed.
Raj (Claymore): billing@claymore.com is right. credit is $6,000 (promo trial credit). we'll upload the signed PO tonight and accept card charge for the remainder.
Liam (Finance): OK. once PO + signed amendment + credit confirmation + card token are in, finance will authorize the card and provision the 15 seats. we will mark those seats as migration-only (non-prod).
Nora (Legal): I'll put the redline in and send to Raj for e-sign. aim: e-sign today, provision Monday.
Maya (CSM): perfect. I'll attach this thread to the renewal ticket and update the playbook with the Claymore split flow. ping me if anything changes. :slightly_smiling_face:
